meta.title: Devlog: August 23, 2026 - August 30, 2026
meta.description: a broader due or die update is taking shape around feedback, playful challenges, and a clearer view of task outcomes.

bullets.text: i'm experimenting with more responsive interactions and mascot reactions, including a little acknowledgement when a task is finished early.
i added a just-for-fun random punishment option so the app can occasionally manufacture trouble without waiting for a missed task.
i'm building a clearer health view around completed, late, and missed work, with the deeper report reserved for premium access.

summary.text: this was a big pass at making due or die feel more alive while also giving the accountability side a little more memory. still in progress, but the app is getting better at both judging me and reacting when i briefly get my life together.
